verdict_rationale: Deterministic physical I2S acquisition over USB CDC verified with 0 in-stream drops across all sessions. G1 firmware rollback / dual-mode compatibility verified pre- and post-flash. Electrical 3.28V rail attested by operators. Acoustic response confirmed with 23.2 dB stimulus-to-quiet ratio. Acoustic calibration, phantom frequency response, and clinical stethoscope certification remain PENDING.

tasks: ESP32-S3 firmware architecture and dual-mode runtime (G1 synthetic / G2 physical I2S)
ESP-IDF v5.5.1 I2S driver configuration (48 kHz, 24-bit in 32-bit slot, Philips mode, DMA ring)
USB CDC binary streaming protocol and frame packaging
Host ingestion pipelines, validation CLI (bringup.py), and desktop application
Automated test suites and regression verification
Breadboard mechanical positioning and jumper routing for INMP441 breakout
Acoustic stimulus positioning and physical handling
Acoustic chamber / chestpiece design exploration (prototype phase)
Bench power supply / USB VDD rail voltage measurement (3.28V on Agilent U1232A, attested)
Multimeter pin-to-pin continuity and short-circuit verification
Hardware test script execution in lab environment (preflight, bringup, qualify)
Lab evidence packaging and handoff return

hardware_configuration.sensor: INMP441 Omnidirectional Bottom-Port I2S MEMS Microphone

g2_sessions.source: Physical USB INMP441 G2 (quiet) on COM3
g2_sessions.notes: High initial RMS caused by I2S FIFO startup transient and DC blocking high-pass settling; settles to 0.0156 RMS.

g2_sessions.source: Physical USB INMP441 G2 (stimulus) on COM3
g2_sessions.notes: High acoustic stimulus volume approached sensor ceiling (peak 0.999982). Near-clipping on 0.2775% of samples.
Intermediate acoustic stimulus level. Verified bit-for-bit SHA256 in second lab return package.
Reduced acoustic stimulus level resulting in 8.0 dB (20-500 Hz) power ratio with reduced near-clipping (0.0575%). Distinct from Stimulus Run 1 (23.2 dB).

telemetry_accounting.interpretation: Leftover DMA buffer drained cleanly upon STOP boundary; 0 samples dropped during active transmission.

provenance_and_git_baseline.explanation: The lab setup executed scripts from commit 319fcc5 where laptop_working_manifest.json was created. The flashed firmware was the precompiled release g2_candidate_20261117 whose SHA-256 hashes match repository files bit-for-bit.

multimeter_photograph.detail: 3.28V rail measured on Agilent U1232A attested by Kaan and Ozan; display photo was not taken.

acoustic_port_macro_photo.detail: Top and angle photos show board wiring; bottom acoustic sound port macro view not captured.

acoustic_calibration.detail: Relative acoustic capture verified (23.2 dB delta), but SPL sensitivity, acoustic phantom, and clinical frequency response are uncalibrated.

stimulus_volume_control.detail: High sound level resulted in 0.2775% near-clipping (>0.98 FS). Subsequent calibration must use calibrated SPL source.
